scripts.build: bun run registry:build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun run --cwd apps/docs build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/registry typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/cli typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/docs typecheck
scripts.test: bun run registry:build && bun run --cwd packages/cli test && bun test packages/registry/tests tests/release-readiness.test.ts
scripts.test:fixtures: bun run registry:build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun scripts/test-fixtures.ts
